rules: Choose a regional source pixel with probability proportional to its spherical area within the stated prospecting pool. Joint six-oxide normal draws use the measured pixel covariance and reject negative abundances; the original six-oxide nonclosure is not normalized. These are model-based regional predictive intervals, not global-average sampling confidence intervals.

Prospecting pools are regional ranking scenarios, not mine designations or independent additive inventories. The nonpolar cut excludes both polar caps geometrically, but does not release nonpolar scientific or heritage sites.

Density-depth follows the Hayne et al. form. Its parameter distributions are disclosed planning priors around published thermal/sample constraints, not measured confidence distributions at 5 or 10 metres.

Global bulk potential integrates area and the assumed density profile. Regional composition is extrapolated at fixed 0.5/1/1.5 depth factors, reported separately; no probability is assigned to this structural choice.

Recovery and process-cost priors use the existing bounded engineering coefficients. Costs cover feed handling and inherited bulk processing, not complete specified-metal extraction, fabrication, freight or qualified extraction rights.
Footprint allowances are alternative planning areas before site-specific exclusions, archives and future-use reserves; no area is authorized by this calculation.
